compiler_limits: The beta clamp, lesion-containing template, dNTPs and expression/activation context are assumed external resources; they are not separately required member nodes.
No arbitrary cross-species functional compatibility is inferred. Negative mixed-panel controls mean insufficient evidence in this audited panel, not demonstrated impossibility.
Family/domain membership is supporting identity evidence only; it never supplies a missing core activity or cassette-level compatibility certificate.
ImuA-prime lacks a unified asserted family ID in the module. Exact reviewed representative identity and the native/ortholog evidence bridge supply the bounded role gate.
Alternative ImuA/ImuA-prime realizers satisfy one required accessory role; both are not required.

Production static logic ignores connections, timing, contextual taxa and kinetic/resource constraints; external evidence oracle supplies panel compatibility. EXACTLY_ONE is at-least-one for static satisfiability, not a claim the other protein must be absent.

Verified Q1D5A2 supplies only a Myxococcus accessory-role witness. No matched ImuB/DnaE2 panel is asserted. Native imuA deletion reduces but does not abolish all induced mutagenesis; required-accessory tests apply to the specified ImuA-containing realization, not all residual TLS.

The Myxococcus ATPase gate identifies an activity-bearing realizer; measured hydrolysis does not establish causal necessity of ATP turnover for native TLS. Failure of that qualified branch is not a negative mutant-function prediction.
